## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The rename leaves the Commands section of `AGENTS.md` pointing at the removed `make test` target; update it, because the guide names these commands as the only checks a change gets.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates the README's test instruction to match. It also adds a Layout section to `AGENTS.md` that lists each file and the Makefile targets, and appends an HTML comment to the README.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- Makefile:6 — comments — Update AGENTS.md Commands to say `make check` — Renaming the target here leaves `AGENTS.md:24` telling contributors to "Run `make test` before you push", a target the Makefile no longer defines. The Layout section this pull request adds to the same file already names the target `check`. — Contributors and agents following the guide get a make error from its pre-push test command, in a repository the guide says has no CI. — Fix: Change `AGENTS.md:24` to name `make check`.

## Not reviewed
- Lines 19–26 of `AGENTS.md` at `pr-72` were not read from the head commit, because the checkout holds a modified working-tree copy without the pull request's hunk; this review inferred them from the diff's single hunk plus that copy, and `git show pr-72:AGENTS.md` confirms them.
